capabilities: Pull Granola meeting notes into the vault as Markdown
Sync transcripts as separate files or combined with notes, with automatic bidirectional links
Write notes into daily-note sections or individual files with configurable folders and filename patterns
Filter meetings by title and schedule automatic periodic syncs
Download note attachments and embed them in synced notes
extras: Desktop-only (not supported on mobile). Independent project not affiliated with or endorsed by Granola; users are responsible for complying with Granola's Terms of Service. Plugin was taken over by @kayacancode from original creator Tom Elliot. Only meetings with a finished AI summary and transcript are synced.
intentEvidence: The most actively maintained Granola sync plugin, and the one that gets the details right
motivation: The author wanted Granola notes to be searchable, linkable, and kept in Obsidian instead of locked away in Granola.
problem: Granola meeting notes and transcripts live locked inside the Granola app, separate from the vault where the rest of your knowledge lives.

relations.evidence: It uses Granola's official public API with an API key you create in your own account.

requires.name: Granola paid plan (required to create API keys)
Granola desktop app (only to create the key)

summary: Syncs Granola meeting notes, transcripts, and attachments into your vault as Markdown files via Granola's official API.
